title: Billboard Latin Music Week 2026 Tickets Are On Sale Now: Save the Date
summary: Tickets are available now at BillboardLatinMusicWeek.com at a discounted rate through July 22.
contentText:
Miami, get ready. Billboard Latin Music Week is officially returning to Faena Forum in Miami Beach, Florida, from Oct. 19-22, and tickets are on sale now, Billboard announced Monday (June 29).

Related

Billboard Latin Music Week Returns to Miami in 2026

Lauyrn Hill Receives Living Legend Icon Award After Incredible Tribute at 2026 BET Awards: 'I Want People to Know What We Can Do'

Kelly Rowland Salutes Sylvia Rhone With Ultimate Icon Award at 2026 BET Awards: 'Music Needs Us to Stand Up for It Like Never Before'

Tickets are available now at BillboardLatinMusicWeek.com at a discounted rate through July 22. Fans can use the code BBPRESALE at checkout for an extra deal.

Known as the longest-running and most prestigious event dedicated to Latin music and culture, Billboard Latin Music Week brings together the biggest stars, rising acts, executives and tastemakers for a few days packed with unforgettable moments. Expect exclusive artist conversations, industry panels, live performances, fan events, networking opportunities and, of course, the Billboard Latin Music Awards, set for Oct. 22.

“We have been part of the history, and the future, of Latin music,” Leila Cobo, Billboard’s co-chief content officer, previously said at the 2025 Latin Music Week press conference. “Latin music is bigger than ever, it’s more global than ever. Around the world, it’s the genre that has grown the fastest.”

If last year was any indication, 2026 is set to be another can’t-miss week. The 2025 edition featured appearances from heavy-hitters including Daddy Yankee, Kali Uchis, Gloria and Emilio Estefan, Anuel AA, Carín León, Laura Pausini, Myke Towers, Ozuna and more. Other superstars who have previously joined include Shakira, Karol G, Romeo Santos, J Balvin, Peso Pluma, Fuerza Regida and others.

For those looking to fully dive in, the Insider + Award Pass includes daytime programming, networking events, lounge access, En Vivo concerts, a commemorative gift bag and a ticket to the Billboard Latin Music Awards.

Sponsors include Harbourview Equity Partners, HYBE, Sonesta International Hotels, the official hotel partner of Billboard Latin Music Week; Lincoln, the official auto partner of Billboard Latin Music Week, and more. 

Reserve your spot now at BillboardLatinMusicWeek.com before presale pricing ends on July 22.
